### 5. 🎯 战略上下文
- **核心方法**: Dual-constrained adaptive b* = inf{b ≥ 0 : α_eff(b) ≥ τ} s.t. ESS(b) ≥ n_min。最小干预准则

Web 预训练语料含 20-60% 合成数据（比例未知）。Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025) 提出 w=(1-q)^b 重加权框架，但 b 需 per-model validation grid search。我们提出 dual-constrained adaptive b*：
- α_eff(b) ≥ τ — 质量下界（至少做够清洁）
- ESS(b) ≥ n_min — 稳定上界（不要清洁过头）
- b* = inf{b ≥ 0 : α_eff(b) ≥ τ} s.t. ESS(b) ≥ n_min — 最小干预准则

   - Dohmatob et al. (2025) — strong model collapse (ICLR 2025)
   - Cheng et al. (2025) — contamination survey

2. **Detect-and-Reweight / Filter**
   - Drayson et al. (2025) — 最直接竞争者，**放最后详细对比**
   - Feng et al. (2025) — verifier-based hard filtering (ICLR 2025)
   - Guo et al. (2025) — verification-based escaping collapse
   - Mitchell et al. (2023) — DetectGPT detector
   - Shi et al. (2024) — Min-k% Prob detector

   - Xie et al. (2023) DoReMi — domain-level 优化
   - Xie et al. (2023) DSIR — data selection via importance resampling
   - He et al. (2024) SoftDedup — 软去重

   - Chen et al. (2025) AIOLI — adaptive online data mixing
   - Ye et al. (2025) — data mixing laws (ICLR 2025)
   - Yang et al. (2026) — data mixing agent
   - Kuo et al. (2024) — data weighting
